name: P4 (lens back reflection)
user: The fourth Purkinje image: the dim reflection of the light on the back of the lens, seen through the pupil. With P1, it gives the eye's rotation in a dual Purkinje (DPI) tracker.
developer: Brightest point inside the pupil (shrunk by an edge margin, P1's surroundings left out), refined as the centroid of brightness above the pupil threshold in a square around it, on the smoothed image (DPI-SPEC 2, 4). Image coordinates, pixel centers at integers (SPEC 9.1). Without a pupil, the pupil's status (no_pupil…); failed when no spot at least min_diameter across is found, or when P1 wasn't found (P1 could be taken for P4). Method: Ryan Ressmeyer's OpenIrisDPI.

fields.name: P4 size
fields.help: Diameter of the spot: √(major × minor) of its moment ellipse, each axis 4√λ of the brightness-weighted second moments. A uniform disk's diameter; 4σ for a Gaussian spot.
